descriptor.visual: A simple workshop bench displaying various early stationary industrial engines side-by-side with motion lines indicating established technology.

proposal.summary: The stationary engines are shown as established technology; a small rotation of the prominent steam-engine flywheel would suggest familiar mechanical operation, but its spokes and underlying details require a clean rotation source.

targets.object: Large spoked flywheel on the steam engine at left
targets.evidence: The wheel is clearly visible beside the steam-engine boiler, with a rim, spokes, and hub; nearby drawn motion marks also suggest rotation.
targets.why: A subtle flywheel rotation conveys a working, established engine without changing its pose or the rest of the illustration.

needsArtwork.reason: Rotating the detailed wheel requires a clean rotation source that preserves its spokes and rim while avoiding artifacts over the engine and background.
